integrity: The proof uses an explicit normalized state pair related by a determinant-one local unitary and exact coefficient-minor arithmetic. No numerical approximation is needed for the theorem.
limitations: The counterexample concerns the 2005 \(W^3\) class functional only; it does not assess the separate GHZ classes or the author's later redefined concurrence.
scientific: Exact local-unitary counterexample to the 2005 \(W^3\) concurrence monotonicity claim.
title: A local-unitary counterexample to the 2005 \(W^3\) concurrence monotonicity claim
